quest.title: A Wish For Smooth Sailing
quest.description: Thanks to everyone's hard work, the Film Fantasyland is now in full swing. You finally have some free time to chat with your companions...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Now that things have reached this point, we should add—

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: A pinch of salt?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: A dash of pepper, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Ah, brilliant!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You two aren't talking about a new dessert menu by any chance, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Pepper sounds a bit out of place in a dessert.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Not desserts.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: We're talking about the script!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Eh?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: My dear partner, photographer, rookie director... Our creativity must keep up with the overflowing enthusiasm of our fans!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: There's no room for dull scripts on my stage! Plot twists should strike the audience like a cloud of pepper, leaving them sneezing in surprise. ACHOO!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: The same logic applies in catering.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: I once heard Miss Emilie mention that pepper could be used in perfumes. Perhaps I could find a way to make it work in desserts too...

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Hmm... A peppery kick to complement the delicate sweetness of cream, perhaps...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, the two of them seem to be working together so well...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's struggling to imagine what a pepper cake would taste like, though!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Well, well, what do we have here? Escoffier's making a new cake?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, and she's peppering in some new ideas.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: How exciting! When it's ready, do let me know — I'd love to try it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it just Paimon, or does it seem like everyone's even more enthusiastic now that they've finished their work?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Why shouldn't they be? When your hard work pays off... that's when you should celebrate!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: It's like a batch of fresh macarons — you should never let fear of sweetness stop you from adding all the filling you please.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: After all, if there's ever a time to pile on the sugar, it's when you're making macarons!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Pile on the sugar!

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: Pile on the sugar!

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: ...And, why are we piling on the sugar?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Lepine-Pauline, you're here! Is it ready?

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: Of course! It all went according to plan!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Were you off on some kind of important task?

dialogues.speaker: Lepine-Pauline
dialogues.text: I was indeed! Please, accept this!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's this...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh wow! It's a panoramic view of the amusement park, with everyone's illustrations on it!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Hehe, since the Film Fantasyland has been such a success, we decided to create a unique souvenir to remember it by.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: We built this park together, brick by brick. So we decided we'd all contribute to drawing this map together, too.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: To be fair, it was mostly thanks to Miss Lepine-Pauline — she's our expert when it comes to drawing, after all. But we all did our best to leave our own marks too.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: That's right!

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: #And on top of that, {NICKNAME}, I'm offering you a most special privilege.

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: You get to add a mustache to my portrait!

talks.objective: Meet up with everyone at the Film Fantasyland

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Awesome! Fancy a <color=#C4D6EAFF>white</color> one?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Cream-flavored, huh? Very traditional, but also... very delicious! Mm-hmm, you have my approval.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Alright then! Now that you're the proud owner of this commemorative map, you can draw as many different flavored mustaches on it as you like.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, sounds like a pretty tasty map. We'll look after it well!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Great! Your satisfaction is our number one priority.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Everything's all in order — now it's time to relax. Forget about work, and just enjoy the park!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Splendiferous! Fancy a <color=#E77E70FF>red</color> one?

dialogues.speaker: Furina
dialogues.text: Bolognese sauce flavor...? Well, that sure counts as a surprise twist! You win this round!
